BEFORE THE NEW MEXICO PUBLIC REGULATION COMMISSION

    IN THE MATTER OF SOUTHWESTERN PUBLIC                                      )
    SERVICE COMPANY’S APPLICATION FOR: (1)                                    )
    REVISION OF ITS RETAIL RATES UNDER ADVICE                                 )    Docket No. 25-00079-UT
    NOTICE 341; AND (2) OTHER ASSOCIATED RELIEF                               )

         ORDER DENYING NMDOJ MOTION TO FILE STATEMENT OF POSITION
                     IN LIEU OF TESTIMONY OUT OF TIME

           THIS MATTER comes before Patrick Schaefer and Keven Gedko, hearing examiners for

the New Mexico Public Regulation Commission (“Commission”), upon the Motion to File a

Statement of Position in Lieu of Testimony Out of Time (“Motion File Statement Out of Time”),

filed by the New Mexico Department of Justice (“NMDOJ”) on July 2, 2026.

           Being duly informed, the Hearing Examiners FIND and CONCLUDE:

           1.       On June 18, 2026, the Hearing Examiners issued an Order Revising Procedural

Deadlines (the “Revised Procedural Order”).

           2.       The Revised Procedural Order, in paragraph G, required that “[i]f a contested

stipulation is filed, the deadline to file testimony in support of the stipulation is June 30, 2026.”

That Order further required, in paragraph K, that “[a]ll signatories to the filed stipulation shall file

testimony in support of the stipulation.”

           3.       The stipulation reached by the parties in this proceeding is contested.

           4.       The NMDOJ is a signatory to the stipulation and was therefore required to file

testimony. Tara Resources Corporation, also a signatory to the stipulation, was required to file

testimony, but submitted a Statement of Position in Lieu of Testimony. It also filed this Statement

beyond the June 30 deadline for testimony.1




1
    Targa Resources Corp. Statement of Position in Lieu of Testimony (July 1, 2026).
                 BEFORE THE NEW MEXICO PUBLIC REGULATION COMMISSION
Order Denying NMDOJ Motion to File Statement Out of Time    Docket No. 25-00079-UT


       5.      The NMDOJ Motion File Statement Out of Time was filed on July 2, 2026, two

full days after the deadline.

       6.      The foundational importance of making timely and compliant filings is set forth in

the Commission’s Rules of Procedure. Rule 1.2.2.11(B)(3) NMAC states that the failure to comply

with an order of the presiding officer requiring the filing of testimony and exhibits may result in

the rejection of the pleading or document without prejudice.

       7.      Furthermore, a Statement of Position filed by a Party’s counsel or representative is

not equivalent to witness testimony. The NMDOJ Statement of Position is offered and signed by

NMDOJ counsel. To admit the NMDOJ Statement of Position into evidence would be to allow the

counsels to testify, which is impermissible.

       8.      Given the foregoing the Hearing Examiners determine that the NMDOJ Statement

of Position is not testimony and therefore not compliant with the Revised Procedural Order.

       IT IS THEREFORE ORDERED:

       The NMDOJ Motion to File Statement Out of Time is DENIED.

       ISSUED under the Seal of the Commission at Santa Fe, New Mexico, on July 9, 2026.

                 NEW MEXICO PUBLIC REGULATION COMMISSION
